source_en: Greetings, officer. Tina Meskhi, accountant. Terribly dull, I promise.
Before you ask, the mask covers old scars. Everyone asks.
Do you ever take it off?
Not for strangers. Though you asked so nicely, officer.
It protects the face beneath. Think of it as very committed skincare.
You play the stern gatekeeper well. My ink is from the office.
Of course. If it grows tiresome, I'm very good with numbers. Discreet ones.
Everything. The difference is whether you're aware of it.
Ledgers are better company. They never ask questions.
